crossRefs.note: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and…
He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets…
It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets…
I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because…
So I fell down before Yahweh the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Yahweh had said he would destroy…
He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.
Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful…
For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all…
He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”
Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by…

translations.web: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
translations.bsb: and He was there for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.
translations.kjv: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
translations.asv: And he was in the wilderness forty days tempted of Satan; And he was with the wild beasts; And the angels ministered unto him.
